headlines.title: Jacobs wins project management role on $37B transmission program
headlines.summary: American Electric Power, the largest U.S. electric transmission system operator, picked the Dallas-based firm to provide integrated delivery services over the next five years.

headlines.title: AEP Creates Infrastructure Business Unit to Support Growing Energy Demand
headlines.summary: American Electric Power (Nasdaq: AEP) has created AEP Infrastructure, a new business unit focused on investing in, building and operating energy infrastructure to meet growing electricity demand. Greg Hall will lead the organization as president and will continue to report to Bill Fehrman, AEP chairman, president and chief executive officer.

headlines.title: AEP Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Growth Outlook and $100B Capital Plan
headlines.summary: American Electric unveils a $100 billion capital plan, raises its long-term earnings growth outlook and reports 84 GW of contracted load amid surging electricity demand.

headlines.title: AEP increases investment plan 30% on generation, transmission spending
headlines.summary: American Electric Power’s contracted large loads jumped 22%, to 84 GW, mainly on a 10.4-GW data center in Ohio being developed by SB Energy, company officials said Wednesday.

description: American Electric Power Company, Inc., an electric public utility holding company, engages in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity for sale to retail and wholesale customers in the United States. It operates through Vertically Integrated Utilities, Transmission and Distribution Utilities, AEP Transmission Holdco, and Generation & Marketing segments. The company generates electricity using coal and lignite, nuclear, natural gas, renewable, hydro, solar, wind, and other energy sources; owns, operates, maintains, and invests in transmission infrastructure; and engages in the retail supply, and wholesale energy trading and marketing businesses. It operates approximately 252,000 circuit miles of distribution lines; 38,000 circuit miles of transmission lines; and 25,000 MWs of regulated owned generating capacity. American Electric Power Company, Inc. was incorporated in 1906 and is headquartered in Columbus, Ohio.
